reason: r44 is the consolidation after the tester accepted r42's gauge: the test scaffolding, the measured ink-track geometry, the fixed-ratio cycle, the tier-packed gauge snapshot and the 134-word sample dump are gone, the accepted cut is stored as offsets on the rect it was measured on (18 and 90 px of its own 128 px) scaled by its live width, names and log text say what the code does, and README.md is the user guide with the tester steps in TESTING.md. r44 ran once on Eden 2026-10-30 with the HD Project on and the tester accepted it on its own bytes; approved for local distribution on 2026-10-30.
runtime_test: RUN ONCE on Eden 2026-10-30. Installed NRO c3da58333cdf4c141fb39ce691cc8e3fa0560251552093e1d659cb850800131f = the packaged payload. The tester's report is that it ran successfully with the MHGU HD Project mod on, covering the melee checks at full, low and empty sharpness with a sharpen back and a quest that crossed an area's loading screen, and that the cut sits where r43 put it. The log (224 of our lines) shows 209 fill lines with ratios from 10000 down to 0, every one on bar rect 110 38 238 166 with feed=128 and the box at widths 18 / 54 / 90 px at 0 / 5000 / 10000 bp, three insertions with a 5-entry map and a 9-record cache, three links-lost teardowns each followed by a new insertion, one stage-21 check before any gauge HUD existed, no insertion failure, no stage 34, and no guest exception (Eden logged 33 of its own maxwell_3d asserts).

limitations: r4 has no runtime test; its lines, the 320-sample budget and the absence of any drawing change are static results.
r2 was built and never run; r3 was run once on Eden and is recorded.
r14 was run once on Eden and failed as reported: the gauge was clipped away from the insertion and the game crashed at the quest end. Its log is the evidence, and the insertion is removed in r15.

r15 was run once on Eden and drew the gauge normally for 740 seconds with no exception; its facts line printed tree_nodes 3 against 4 objects, and its object-list fields were read from the wrong object (the controller's owner field), which is what r16 fixes.

r16 changes nothing on screen: it reads game memory and logs. No drawing, no gauge change, and no cleanup claim (the root-destructor hook fired zero times in the three sessions that logged it). Its Eden run ended in Eden's own shutdown records (maxwell_3d Critical asserts, ForceStop, host SIGSEGV) with zero guest exceptions.
the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block r17 publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and r17 frees the old 4-word block itself
The per-weapon tier tables live in RomFS weapon data and are not read in this workspace: no weapon data file is extracted here.
The gauge itself is not part of r4.

r25 has not been run. r24's run drew the gauge from the quest start and lost it at an area change, where a mask kept clipping after its links broke; the disable-on-loss path has no runtime evidence, and a mask inserted into a second area's row has never been observed (r24's log ends 12 s after the transition, gauge HUD absent)
r40 has not been run. Its two defaults are the endpoints the r39 log shows applied (right edge 129 px at 0% and 201 px at 100%), read from the tester's run, not from an r40 run.
r42 has not been run. Its fill comes from the player fields Phase 1 verified and the r41 run's accepted geometry; the per-frame fill has not been seen on screen.
r43 has not been run. 128 px at 0% is proven by the r42 log (the tester dragged the start there); 200 px at 100% is the tester's measurement, and that run's box ended at 201.

r44 ran once on Eden 2026-10-30 (HD Project on, melee quest, an area change and a quest end). Its box arithmetic is offsets scaled by the bar rect's live width, and every logged line in that run carried the measured 110..238 rect, so the scaled form has only been seen where it reproduces r43's boxes.
The thread that runs the draw walker at main+0xa494a0 is unproven, and the run did not change that: no bl site, stored word or DTI property in main names that entry.

evidence.static_summary: r44: pinned toolchain build; 20 host fixtures passed; verify.py PASSED with 21 NSO signature windows, a unique hook window, the exact export set, resolved imports only, no MSR in the disassembly, no DT_TEXTREL and a one-file payload. See EVIDENCE.json and DEVELOPMENT.md.
evidence.manual_summary: r44 ran once on Eden 2026-10-30 with the installed NRO matching the packaged payload: 224 of our lines, 209 fill lines with ratios 10000 down to 0, every one on bar rect 110 38 238 166 with feed=128 and box widths 18 / 54 / 90 px at 0 / 5000 / 10000 bp, three insertions with a 5-entry map and a 9-record cache, three links-lost teardowns each followed by a new insertion, no insertion failure and no guest exception. The tester reported it ran successfully with the HD Project mod on and the cut where r43 put it. Prior accepted evidence (r41 geometry, r42 fill) is in EVIDENCE.json and backups/accepted/.

Ships the r44 candidate bytes unchanged (NRO c3da58333cdf4c141fb39ce691cc8e3fa0560251552093e1d659cb850800131f, candidate ZIP 19af9431338202171c70b5991d455871e32d6df8b725d93d03270cfddc2f0d00), preserved in backups/accepted/modern-sharpness-gauge/r44-distribution-approved/. That version ran once on Eden 2026-10-30 with the installed NRO matching the packaged payload; the tester reported it ran successfully and that the cut sits where r43 put it at full, low and empty sharpness, with the MHGU HD Project mod on, across an area change and a quest end. It does not prove native Switch hardware, Ryujinx, a bar rect other than 110..238, or the thread the draw walker runs on.
